item.title: BJP single-largest party in Rajasthan urban polls, denied sweep by Independents
item.description: The recent urban local body elections in Rajasthan showcased the significant influence of independent candidates on the outcome. Although the BJP secured the most seats, they did not dominate as expected, while Congress demonstrated resilience by winning important contests in several towns. The strong showing by independents indicates a shift toward local issues rather than party allegiance. Additionally, the announcement of results was hampered by technical glitches in some areas.

item.title: Scotland, Northern Ireland and Wales sign historic MoU to break away from UK
item.description: Leaders from Scotland, Northern Ireland, and Wales signed a pact seeking independence. This historic agreement signals a shift away from Westminster's long-standing control. The first ministers are committed to self-determination for their respective nations. They also aim to strengthen cooperation on economic and energy matters. This pact reflects a growing desire for constitutional change across these regions.
item.dc:creator: NAOMI CANTON

item.title: Homeless pianist went viral after church performance; 2 years later, he has a home
item.description: In January 2024, homeless man Rhys Wynne-Jones went to a church in England for shelter and asked to play its piano. His performance of Queen’s “Bohemian Rhapsody” went viral. Two years later, he has found a home, performed at charity events, worked with Peter Andre and raised more than £40,000 for homeless charities and other good causes.
item.dc:creator: TOI WORLD DESK

item.title: Oracle layoffs: Employees receive ‘6am job cuts’ email from Oracle leadership again
item.description: Oracle layoffs began again on September 14, with employees across the US reporting the same 6am email from "Oracle Leadership" that landed in March. Logins were disabled around 4am, Slack access dropped by 5.30am, and Slack counts fell by 3,000 to 4,000. OCI, Fusion, NetSuite, Oracle Health and the Abilene Stargate site were hit. India's Development Centre is expected next, as Oracle's restructuring bill climbs to $2.8 billion.

item.title: Perez Hilton cuts Las Vegas mansion price by $350,000 after Miami move
item.description: Perez Hilton has reduced the asking price of his 6,600-square-foot Las Vegas mansion by $350,000, from $4.25 million to $3.9 million. Hilton listed the six-bedroom home in June after moving to Miami with his three children. The property includes six en-suite bedrooms, a detached casita, multigenerational suite, pool and outdoor entertaining space.

item.title: Atlanta begins next phase to turn Microsoft-donated land to 20,000 housing units
item.description: Microsoft donated land in Atlanta for affordable housing initiatives. This donation supports Mayor Andre Dickens' goal of twenty thousand housing units. A community celebration will mark the land donation and future plans. The Quarry Yards property will focus on community development and resident opportunities. This project advances a shared vision for strengthening local communities.

item.title: Massachusetts dairy turns manure and food waste into $155,000 annual savings
item.description: Jordan Dairy Farms in Rutland, Massachusetts, embraces cutting-edge anaerobic digestion technology to revolutionize waste management. By transforming cow manure and food scraps into energy and fertilizer, the farm not only boosts its sustainability but also slashes operational costs. This innovative approach not only supports the farm’s productivity but also significantly mitigates its environmental footprint, showcasing a model for responsible agriculture.

item.title: Travis Kelce’s $5.35M home: What did Ohio mayor say about the controversy?
item.description: Travis Kelce’s reported Ohio property has drawn attention after neighbors raised concerns about plans for a privacy fence around the lakefront estate. Bratenahl Mayor Keith Benjamin addressed the issue, stressing that the village welcomes high-profile residents while respecting their privacy. The property, near Kelce’s childhood home, spans 3.5 acres and features eight bedrooms, 11 bathrooms, a theater, fitness center, sauna, guest cottage and a former speakeasy.

item.title: Trinity Rodman’s inspiring journey: How did she overcome Dennis Rodman’s shadow?
item.description: Trinity Rodman’s journey goes far beyond soccer. As a child, she lived with her mother and brother in a car and motels during a difficult period. Her mother, Michelle Moyer, became her biggest support and role model. Today, Trinity is an Olympic champion, NWSL champion and the league’s highest-paid player, after building her career on her own terms.

item.title: 'Why wasn't FIR slapped on Justice Varma?' Senior lawyer Mahesh Jethmalani
item.description: Leading lawyers called for judicial reform and increased transparency in the system. They questioned the lack of an FIR after cash was found at a judge's residence. Chief Justice Surya Kant defended the judiciary's internal complaint redressal mechanism. He stated that most complaints arise from disgruntled litigants after court reversals. Lawyers also criticized the opaqueness in judicial appointments and transfers.
item.dc:creator: DHANANJAY MAHAPATRA

item.title: BJP stays on top, Cong gets a warning: What Raj civic polls result means for 2028
item.description: The recent civic poll outcomes in Rajasthan underscore the enduring hold of the BJP despite some setbacks. Both the Aam Aadmi Party and CPM saw significant advancements in certain districts. Meanwhile, it was a mixed bag for the Congress. The Congress victories were scattered even as it ceded some ground to emerging opponents. Independents also played a pivotal role, and this may affect the formation of local boards.
item.dc:creator: KUNAL VARMA

item.title: UP polls & the fight for Muslim votes: Decoding SP, Congress's Owaisi problem
item.description: Asaduddin Owaisi's AIMIM is actively pursuing alliances with opposition parties in preparation for the upcoming elections in Uttar Pradesh. AIMIM's strategy revolves around consolidating its Muslim voter base to compete with major parties like the Samajwadi Party and Congress, which are also targeting this demographic. Should the opposition remain divided, the BJP could exploit these fractures for electoral gains.

item.description: The Bharatiya Janata Party secured a significant victory in Rajasthan's municipal elections. BJP emerged as the largest party, winning more wards than Congress. The party achieved majorities in four out of ten municipal corporations. Prime Minister Modi thanked voters for their support and trust. These results reflect public approval of the BJP's development policies.

item.title: Legendary fashion designer Bob Mackie dies at 87
item.description: Legendary fashion and costume designer Bob Mackie has died at 87, with the news confirmed on his official social media accounts. Known for his dazzling creations for Cher, Diana Ross and Carol Burnett, Mackie earned nine Primetime Emmy Awards and a Tony Award. Miley Cyrus, Sabrina Carpenter, Coco Rocha, Laverne Cox and others paid tribute.

item.title: ‘Same govt had closed the case’: Supriya questions fresh CBI probe into Disha's death
item.description: The CBI has registered an FIR into Disha Salian's death following a court directive. This action surprised political leaders who noted the case was previously closed. The FIR invokes serious charges, though no individuals are named as accused. Salian's father provided names of individuals he wants examined by investigators. The case remains sub judice, with calls for it not to be politicized.

item.title: Quote of the day by Helen Mirren
item.description: Helen Mirren, the acclaimed actress, encourages individuals to grab opportunities without lingering doubts. She asserts that making a significant impression necessitates daring and active choices. Mirren's extensive journey through theatre, television, and film demonstrates that courage is built through facing life's challenges. This viewpoint underscores the essential role of risk-taking in fostering personal advancement.

item.title: BJP to contest all 117 Punjab assembly seats alone, Satish Poonia says ‘no alliance’
item.description: The BJP will contest all 117 Punjab Assembly seats independently in the upcoming elections. Party leader Satish Poonia criticized the AAP government's handling of law and order. He highlighted issues of drug menace and corruption as key campaign points. An anti-drug awareness campaign will be organized across Punjab next month. Union Home Minister Amit Shah will attend the campaign's culmination event.

item.title: Trump moves to scrap Biden-era carbon limits on US coal & gas power plants
item.description: The Trump administration plans to repeal Biden-era emission limits for power plants. This action removes restrictions on a major source of greenhouse gas pollution. The Environmental Protection Agency will announce the final rule soon. Environmental groups oppose the rollback, citing health and safety concerns. Legal challenges are expected against these policy changes.

item.title: Gurgaon hit-and-run: Biker's father seeks attempt to murder charge against driver
item.description: A biker named Sia alleges a hit-and-run incident occurred on Golf Course Road. Her father learned of the accident an hour after it happened. Sia plans to file a police report and pursue legal action with her lawyer. She has declined media interviews and will share updates via Instagram. Gurgaon Police have taken suo motu cognisance and will identify and arrest the accused.

item.title: Varun Chakaravarthy ruled out of Afghanistan T20I series
item.description: The injury comes as a blow for Varun Chakaravarthy and India. He had recently recovered from a hamstring injury that had kept him out of white ball matches in England in July. In the first T20I against Afghanistan, the 35-year-old picked up a wicket while conceding just 16 runs in his four overs.
item.dc:creator: TANUJ LAKHINA

item.title: Why housing is becoming a major political headache for South Korea’s Lee
item.description: South Korean President Lee Jae-myung's approval rating has fallen to a new low. Housing policy and cabinet appointments are key drivers of public dissatisfaction. Critics argue measures have locked buyers out of urban housing markets. The Blue House acknowledges multiple policy and political issues are contributing. The president plans direct public outreach to address concerns.
item.dc:creator: YASHASVI VASISTHA

item.title: Kejriwal-Sardesai Goa gambit: Attack defections, welcome rivals
item.description: The Aam Aadmi Party and Goa Forward Party have unveiled their 'Goa First' coalition in preparation for the 2027 elections. This initiative aims to connect with voters disillusioned by frequent party changes. Leaders Kejriwal and Sardesai advocate a non-BJP, non-Congress option for locals. Historical elections exhibit notable shifts in party loyalties, while this alliance's inclusive approach may offer both chances and obstacles.
item.dc:creator: PALLAVI
